blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around College Park PM

items.t: College Park is an established residential area at Port Moody's west end, next to Glenayre and Seaview near the Burnaby border, in the Clarke Road / Barnet Highway side of the city south of the inlet. The City's OCP material names College Park among the city's older single detached areas. Exact board sub-area boundary roads are not verified.

Nearby areas: Glenayre and Seaview next door, Port Moody Centre to the east, Burnaby (Burnaby Mountain / SFU side) to the west. Barnet Highway (Highway 7A) and St. Johns Street run east–west through the city toward Burnaby and Coquitlam. Driving commute times: Not verified.

Transit: TransLink buses connect west Port Moody to Moody Centre Station (Millennium Line Evergreen Extension and West Coast Express); Moody Centre and Inlet Centre are the city's two SkyTrain stops, east of this area. Specific route numbers on College Park streets are not verified.

Community Port Moody (medians are published at community level only; sub-area medians are not verified): detached median $1,685,000, $608/sq ft, 96% sale-to-list, 33 days; condos & townhomes median $715,000, $666/sq ft, 94%, 29 days. Land has NO SnapStats category — no figure above is a land figure.

Schools (SD43 Coquitlam, Ministry-listed names): SD43 schools in this part of Port Moody include Glenayre Elementary and Seaview Community School, with Moody Middle and Port Moody Secondary serving central Port Moody.

Recreation: Glenayre Centre at 492 Glencoe Drive is the City community centre in the adjoining Glenayre neighbourhood, and the Port Moody Recreation Complex is at 300 Ioco Road; Port Moody Public Library is at 100 Newport Drive. Parks inside College Park itself: Not verified on an official source. Rocky Point Park and the Shoreline Trail at the head of the inlet are the city's waterfront park system east of this area.
Health: Eagle Ridge Hospital is in Port Moody at 475 Guildford Way (Fraser Health), east of this area.
Shopping: no shopping centre or grocery store location inside College Park was verified on an official source: Not verified.
How people search for it: "College Park Port Moody," "College Park PM." No other official alternate name was confirmed: Not verified.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in College Park PM

items.t: OCP — Port Moody Official Community Plan Bylaw 2026 No. 3522 (adopted Apr 28, 2026, repeals Bylaw No. 2955 — never cite 2955 as current): Its Chapter 14 sets policy for the city's neighbourhoods; the Suncor refinery lands beside College Park and Seaview are designated a Special Study Area, which is the main planning item hanging over this end of the city.

Zoning — Port Moody Zoning Bylaw No. 2937: single detached homes in RS zones and multi-residential homes in RT and RM zones; small-scale multi-unit housing is permitted in RS and RT zones outside the transit-oriented areas. Any parcel's actual zone: per-parcel, not verified.

SSMUH / small-lot position — Port Moody, as the City states it: small-scale multi-unit housing, including coach houses and accessory dwelling units, is permitted in RS and RT zones outside the transit-oriented areas; the transit-oriented areas are exempt from the SSMUH rules. Small lots: RS1-S small lot subdivision (minimum 9 m width and 325 m²) is available only in Moody Centre, Seaview and Pleasantside OCP Single Family–Low Density areas — College Park is not on that list, so confirm any lot-split idea with the City before relying on it.
Subdivision and servicing — Port Moody: no verified bylaw number exists, held not confirmed

Riparian / slope diligence: watercourse lots need a riparian assessment and Zoning Bylaw Section 5.4 setbacks, and environmentally sensitive (DPA 4) and steep-slope (DPA 5) development permit areas can apply. Whether a specific lot is in a permit area: Not verified per parcel.

Property taxes — City of Port Moody: 2026 taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on outstanding amounts after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 15, 2026; utilities are billed separately, with the 2026 utility bill due February 27, 2026.

ALR block (carried for completeness — no ALR land was confirmed in College Park): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)). Caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Check a parcel on the ALC maps.

blocks.text: Duplexes and half duplexes in College Park
What a duplex looks like in College Park

items.t: The ordinary form: College Park's stock is mostly single detached homes — the OCP material groups College Park with the older Moody Centre, Glenayre and Seaview areas for detached stock — with a smaller attached (strata) component.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in College Park

items.t: Zoning and SSMUH: Zoning Bylaw 2018, No. 2937 puts single detached homes in RS zones and multi-residential homes in RT and RM zones. Under Bylaw Amendment No. 94, 2024, No. 3460, small-scale multi-unit housing is permitted in RS and RT zones outside the transit-oriented areas (the TOAs are exempt from the SSMUH rules): Up to four units on lots from 280 m² to 4,050 m², and up to six units within 400 m of frequent bus stops. A duplex is the baseline two-unit form inside that permission. Trap specific to this sub-area: The RS1-S small-lot subdivision standard (minimum 9 m width, 325 m²) is available only in Moody Centre, Seaview and Pleasantside OCP Single Family–Low Density areas — College Park is not on that list, so do not price a College Park lot off the small-lot offer; confirm any split idea with the City.

Hazards / DPAs: The OCP provides environmentally sensitive area and hazardous lands / steep slope development permit areas (DPA 4 and DPA 5), and watercourse lots need riparian assessment under Zoning Bylaw Section 5.4; no floodplain or ALR land was confirmed in College Park.
